title: Starter Beacon hero, pathway diagram and screenshot stencil
creator: Maya Chen
description: Refresh the quickstart landing hero and supporting micro-diagrams to better communicate the "starter" path for new developer signups. Deliver a hero composition (abstracted product UI + stylized device), a progressive pathway diagram that breaks the first three steps into digestible cards, and a screenshot stencil pack for engineers to capture reproducible product screenshots across light/dark and desktop/mobile. Focus on clarity for first-time users, lower cognitive load, and assets that are easy for marketing and docs to reuse.
acceptance_criteria: Hero layout: three responsive variants (desktop wide, tablet centered, mobile stacked) exported as PNG + SVG + Figma component with tokens
Pathway diagram: 3 step progressive states + hover/tooltip treatments in prototype; copy aligns with PM-approved microcopy
Screenshot stencil pack: 6 frame templates (desktop/dark, desktop/light, mobile/dark, mobile/light, CLI screenshot, API key masked) with overlay guides for cropping and autofocus
Accessibility: color contrast checked (AA) for hero CTAs and pathway labels; alt-text recommendations included
Hand-off: Figma file with named components, export presets, and a short README with usage examples and links to PRDs and console routes
Design review: sign-off from PM (Diego Alvarez) and Engineering lead (Liam O'Connor) recorded in comments
